title: Earthquakes recorded in the ground
text: Geologists dug a trench across the Garlock Fault south of the El Paso Mountains. Buried fissures and fault scarps there record five to eight surface-rupturing earthquakes in the past 5,000 years. A deeper dig later confirmed that the timing between earthquakes was irregular.
